The antitrust regulator is likely to approve the combination before its review period runs out, according to a CTFN report on Monday, which cited a person familiar with the matter.

The deal still needs approval from Brazil's antitrust regulator, the Administrative Council for Economic Defense. CADE's blessing is the last regulatory approval needed to close the transaction. CADE opened its formal review of the deal on Aug. 7.
